thread:
jamie: hey all, quick onboarding snag — unboxed my monitor but power brick isn't in the package. monitor is ASUS ProArt PA279CV, desk 1F. currently borrowing a phone charger for the USB-C but it's not stable for 4k. who should i ping to get an official replacement before monday? :grimacing:

it-sara: welcome jamie! sorry about that. can you confirm the packing slip number and whether the monitor came with a detachable power brick or a hardwired cable? sometimes the warehouse separates accessories. if shipping missing we'll escalate.

jamie: packing slip ONB-1042. the monitor expects an external 19V brick (not USB-C PD). box had cable but no brick. carrier status shows delivered.

logistics_max: thanks, looking into ONB-1042 now. i see "accessory missing" flag on the fulfillment. i'll open a carrier investigation, but we can expedite a spare power brick from local inventory for next-day delivery to your desk.

it-sara: meanwhile, if you need temporary stable Wi-Fi for meetings, we can provision temporary wired connection to the nearest wall jack (i'll submit a desk cabling ticket) or loan a USB-C-to-DisplayPort cable and use your laptop charger for power. for record, can you run `dmesg | tail -n 20` when the USB-C PD disconnects so we can see if the dock is dropping power negotiation?

jamie: here's the dmesg snippet from when it lost PD:

```
[  45.123456] usb 2-1: new SuperSpeed device number 4 using xhci_hcd
[  47.654321] usb 2-1-port1: couldn't find PMQS device
[  48.001234] usb 2-1: USB disconnect, device number 4
```
jamie: i'll take the loaner cable for now and welcome the spare brick tomorrow. thanks for the fast triage!

it-bot: Ticket TKT-5011 created: "Monitor power brick missing from ONB-1042 1 expedited local spare to be delivered".

it-sara: noted. @logistics_max will confirm delivery window. if the carrier recovers the missing item we'll cancel the spare pickup.

jamie: perfect. also super appreciate the quick help 44d
metadata: onboarding: missing monitor power brick, temporary workarounds, expedited logistics
